newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Coupons drop on Saudi three- and five-year FRNs.
newsitem.headline: Coupons drop on Saudi three- and five-year FRNs.

text.p: Coupons dropped on three- and five-year Floating Rate Notes worth one billion riyals offered by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA), bankers in the kingdom said on Monday.
SAMA offered the FRNs on Saturday. Their coupons were fixed on Monday for settlement on Wednesday.

The rate for three-year notes maturing on February 26, 2000 fell to 5.7600 percent from 5.8375 percent last month and the five-year coupons maturing on February 26, 2002 dropped to 5.9100 percent from 5.9875 percent.
The notes are fixed at 15 basis points over the Saudi interbank offered rate for three years and 30 basis points over for five years.
Bankers said the five-year FRNs were heavily oversubscribed by banks. "They were oversubscribed by 2.3 billion riyals," one Riyadh-based banker told Reuters.
